scope: Selected released loot methods, official vanilla default routing reference and exact shipped resource graph. Loader changes, custom entity loot tables, death gates, RNG and full survival reachability are not certified.

king_bambambam.selection: one outer selection; selected multi entry expands all four unconditional armor children

tyrosaur.selection: one outer selection; selected multi entry expands all four unconditional armor children

treasure_box.selection: one independent item entry per base roll

limits: A structure spawn override supplies a spawn list, not a guaranteed occupant or fixed spawn time.
Spacing30/separation8 are random-spread placement settings, not a promise of a pit every30chunks.
hasDrops and inherited death/loot gates still apply; custom loot-table fields can override defaults.
No runtime or private Enderloom acceptance is implied.
